objects.triage_title: Side-24 d=3 periodization correction, finite-torus reduction and rational interval certificate (LS-DER-055..064; LS-DATA-055..064)
objects.triage_summary: These files derive the universal first periodization correction and the exact finite-torus Gaussian-cone reduction in d=3 and in arbitrary d. They evaluate the side-24 relative correction (about -1.4862e-118, P_3(24)e^-288) and give a Poisson-dual rational interval certificate. The precision-corrected 280-digit evaluation and the Hessian remainder repair are included, together with verifier sources and results.
objects.triage_hint: Reviewed by CL-AUD-LSDER062-20260728-01 (DQ-086) and CL-AUD-LSDER071 Gate A (DQ-099); no census rows
